findings.title: Six current-subject self-references still identify v3 as v2
findings.measurement: A recursive string-path scan for case-insensitive 'this v2' returns exactly six hits. Five basedOn roles say that 'This v2 remasures' the current occupancy after their respective source, and failsIf[1] refers to closure 'by this v2 file existing'. The subject identifies itself as artifact harness.DR-G14.language-runtime-ux.typescript.v3 with version 3 and routes later recording to 'this v3 occupancy'.
findings.whyTheyAreNotHistorical: The predecessor history is separately and correctly carried in basedOn.predecessorV2, proposedLaterWork[6], doesNot[28], and remeasurementClause. The six charged strings instead use the demonstrative 'This/this' to describe the artifact presently consuming naming v6, D-086, D-179, D-206, D-212, or its own failsIf guard. None is a quote from frozen v2 or labeled historical.
findings.internalContradiction: purpose and authorityClaim call this the v3 successor, proposedLaterWork offers a later recording of this v3 occupancy, and the prompt explicitly attacks v2 speaker labels. The six stale strings make the v3 lineage internally inconsistent even though their substantive source facts are correct.
findings.whyNotABlocker: The wrong version token changes no digest, leftover set, live G14 cell, owner, platform, fixture status, threshold status, or readiness count. It is a bounded successor-currency defect, not a semantic or custody failure.
findings.route: Change the demonstrative self-reference in basedOn.namingV6.role and basedOn.d086/d179/d206/d212.role from 'This v2' to 'This v3'; change failsIf[1] from 'this v2 file existing' to 'this v3 file existing'. Preserve historical v2 references, including basedOn.predecessorV2 and the correct 'G10 occupancy v2 recorded' clause inside basedOn.d212.role.
findings.acceptanceTest: The six listed loci identify the current subject as v3; a recursive case-insensitive search for the phrase 'this v2' returns zero; predecessor/frozen-v2 history and the G10 occupancy-v2 fact remain unchanged.
